title: NFRA_OPLGTW OG-zs-1: attach auth-validator-edge to CloudFront behavior /json-tiered/* (row Z-S114, CTO ruling 34093; A1 accepts the 2-change plan on three conditions)
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~Z

legs.target: the root plan reads 0 to add, 1 or 2 to change, 0 to destroy and the second change is ONLY aws_wafv2_web_acl.opal_cloudfront_protection
legs.proof_required: the Plan: line plus the per-resource list from W/ZS1_PLAN.txt

legs.target: A1 conditions (i) and (ii): the live ACL's rule set is IDENTICAL either side of the apply
legs.proof_required: W/ZS1_ACL_BEFORE.json and W/ZS1_ACL_AFTER.json with equal rules_sha256 over the whole ordered rule list

legs.target: safe-apply lands the one association on behavior 7 and the distribution reaches status Deployed
legs.proof_required: the apply output, the live LambdaFunctionAssociations read back on that behavior, and the distribution Status

legs.target: the hole is closed and nothing else moved: bare path refuses unauthenticated, the twin still serves authenticated, and exactly ONE UpdateWebACL call
legs.proof_required: W/ZS1_PROOF.json -- bare_unauth_status, twin_authed_status, updatewebacl_calls from CloudTrail with its lag probe
